original_audio_policy: restore original AAC stream at final assembly and verify decoded PCM hash
opening_policy: Six source-contiguous ~3.8s pieces to bound long-shot sampling cost; same references/settings, no timeline change.
long_shot_policy: Bound remaining long model shots at 150 source frames, keeping all source frames and cuts in order.
priority: main male identity, outfit and performance
all visible women facial identity, best effort
prompt_review_note: v1 pilots invented additional people; revised descriptions name the source subjects and counts. Pilots14 and26 retain the exact v2 tested prompts.
continuity_policy: Actual source cuts; only the22.625-second opening exceeds15s and is split at15s with22frames of generated motion overlap. No continuity guide crosses a true camera cut.
parallel_reason: 85GiB host RAM available before model load; two CPU-offloaded BF16 copies plus activations and long-video conditioning lack safe headroom; swap already full.

latent_lock.note: Target latent = source latent; tokens 0-17 (frames 0-59) generated, token 18 (frames 60-63) 50/50 latent blend, tokens 19-41 (frames 64-140) held at source. Prompt, photos, seed and recipe are the no-audio baseline, unchanged.

text_prompts: foreground blonde woman wearing black outfit
spatial_preservation.note: Pilot reviewed as sampled frames. Full mask set requires review before batch. Distinct from clip4 temporal tail lock.

mesh_pilot.guide: 68 landmarks per person with triangulation; source-tracked early profile
